fields.description: Healthy workers can receive jobs. Draining prevents new assignments while existing jobs finish.
fields.label: Health Status

fields.description: Tie-breaker only. Routing first prefers a warm worker and then the lowest current load.
fields.label: Routing Priority

fields.description: Maximum JoyMedia attempts that may be Queued or Running on this worker.
fields.label: Max Concurrent Jobs

fields.description: Optional estimated operating cost for one GPU hour. Leave blank when cost reporting is unavailable.
fields.label: GPU Cost Per Hour

fields.description: Current Queued or Running JoyMedia attempts assigned to this worker. Recomputed by the worker monitor.
fields.label: Active Jobs

fields.description: Base URL for this ComfyUI worker, for example http://worker-1:8188.
fields.label: Endpoint URL

fields.description: Absolute ComfyUI input directory on this worker. Leave blank only when the worker uses the site default comfyui_input_dir.
fields.label: Input Directory

fields.description: Model cache key this worker is intended to keep warm. Leave blank for a general-purpose fallback worker.
fields.label: Desired Model Cache Key

fields.description: Model cache key confirmed by trusted worker-side telemetry. Standard ComfyUI system statistics do not provide this value.
fields.label: Observed Model Cache Key
